dev200.selection: stream split=train in source order; retain original integer labels 0 through 199; break when label>=200; no random class-selection seed, no label remap, no per-class cap; num-images cap 400000 is inactive
dev200.preprocessing: Use RGB images from the resized-256 source; if not 256x256, PIL resize((256,256)) with no explicit resample argument
dev200.runtime_image_augmentation: none; no random crop/flip in CustomDataset
dev200.record_count_scope: manifest and matching PNG/latent filenames retrieved 2026-10-05; saved experiment arguments point to this corpus; historical image-byte identity was not established

imagenet1k.selection: downloaded train parquet shards; no intentional class subsampling; exact reason corpus has 8714 fewer files than canonical 1281167 was not recovered
imagenet1k.preprocessing: RGB; bicubic resize shortest edge to256 with round() dimensions, then integer-centered 256x256 crop
imagenet1k.runtime_image_augmentation: none; no random crop/flip in CustomDataset
imagenet1k.record_count_scope: manifest and matching PNG/latent filenames retrieved 2026-10-05; saved experiment arguments point to this corpus; historical image-byte identity was not established

base_recipe.vae_posterior: fresh sample mean+std*eps from cached posterior moments on every presentation
base_recipe.label_dropout: single model-internal class-label dropout, probability0.1; legacy double-drop path disabled
base_recipe.augmentation: no random image augmentation in training loader

batchwise_targets.LAP-L: FP32 torch.linalg.lstsq([patchify(clean_latent), ones], target) across local B*256 token rows; subtract fitted target; no cross-GPU gather
batchwise_targets.L_b256_original_four_arms: seed0: 1GPU x64 accumulation4; seed1:4GPUs x64 accumulation1
batchwise_targets.source: train.py:167-201,418-426,575-579; saved args and results/ckargs_sep30_* layout records

fid_dinov2.feature: DINOv2-B/14 final normalized CLS token (x_norm_clstoken), D768
fid_dinov2.reference: fresh shuffled subset of training-corpus images per evaluation, no fixed reference-feature cache
fid_dinov2.evaluation_rng_seed: not explicitly set by gen_fid.py or its launchers
fid_dinov2.generated_pixel_conversion: clamp decoded float images to[0,1] then multiply255; no uint8 cast before DINO encoder

fid50k.features_and_metrics: ADM/guided-diffusion evaluator: Inception FID, IS, precision, recall

purifier_class_probe.split_permutation: torch.randperm over CustomDataset sorted file order
purifier_class_probe.token_features: 8 token positions sampled with replacement per image; mean logits at evaluation

linear_probe.early_stop: check every500iterations; stop when CE improvement<1e-4
linear_probe.normalization: own fit-feature mean, raw-target fit-feature per-dimension std +1e-6

purifier_class_probe.linear_reference: per-batch affine residual with probe-extraction batch128
purifier_class_probe.linear_reference_split_boundary: Extraction batches can straddle probe subsets; affine coefficients can therefore use images on both sides. Class-probe fit and evaluation image IDs are disjoint.
purifier_class_probe.feasible: for BOTH pooled/token: acc(residual)>=acc(linear_residual)-delta AND acc(residual)-acc(prediction)>delta
purifier_class_probe.selection: largest feasible among tested candidates; original DINOv2/CLIP k3 checkpoints remain historical pilot choices, not retroactively selected from later larger-k probes
